test_SimpleTrainer: test SimpleTrainer by creating a model, dataloader, optimizer, and calling trainer.train with start and max iterations
test_DefaultTrainer: test DefaultTrainer by configuring MODEL.META_ARCHITECTURE, DATASETS.TRAIN, and OUTPUT_DIR then instantiating with get_cfg
test_EvalHook: test EvalHook by registering it on a trainer with a period and mock evaluation function returning metrics
test_PeriodicCheckpointer: test PeriodicCheckpointer by saving checkpoints every N iterations and resuming optimizer state and learning rate
test_PeriodicWriter: test PeriodicWriter by registering CommonMetricPrinter and JSONWriter hooks to log metrics during training
